definition: Auto-WEKA is an automated machine learning system based on Weka by Chris Thornton, Frank Hutter, Holger H.
details: Hoos and Kevin Leyton-Brown. An extended version was published as Auto-WEKA 2.0. Auto-WEKA was named the first prominent AutoML system in a neutral comparison study. It received the test-of-time award of the SIGKDD conference in 2023.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Auto-WEKA — a small key that opens a big door.
